corrections.text: The article states that 'Socket added that a Rust-based plugin outperforms Babel but remains up to 50% slower than direct Oxc integration because of data passing and AST cloning overhead.' Socket's post attributes this to Evan You's argument ('Evan You argued that React Compiler exposes a performance tradeoff in Oxc'); it is a maintainer's claim reported by Socket, not a measurement by Socket.
